patterns_extracted.name: REHYPE_SANITIZE_WITH_REACT_MARKDOWN
patterns_extracted.lesson: XSS protection for markdown rendering requires explicit rehype-sanitize configuration. Sanitization is not automatic in react-markdown.

patterns_extracted.name: CLIPBOARD_TIMEOUT_CLEANUP
patterns_extracted.lesson: Custom clipboard hooks must clean up timeouts in useEffect return. Memory leaks occur when timeout fires after component unmounts.

patterns_extracted.name: COPY_PENDING_CONTENT_NOT_FINAL
patterns_extracted.lesson: Streaming UX requires concatenating both finalized content AND pending content before copy. Users expect complete output even while streaming.

antipatterns_found.name: COMPONENT_DUPLICATION_BEFORE_EXTRACTION
antipatterns_found.evidence: ThinkingBlock logic appeared in message-bubble, thinking-block, and agent-output-viewer before extraction. Required iteration 3 to consolidate.

xss_protection.rationale: Agent output is untrusted (comes from Claude API). XSS attack surface includes markdown injection with script tags.

memory_leak_fix.decision: Return cleanup function from useEffect in useCopyToClipboard
memory_leak_fix.rationale: setTimeout without cleanup accumulates if component re-renders during feedback period. Long-running app will leak memory.

pending_content_copy.decision: Include both msg.content + msg.pendingContent in copy operation
pending_content_copy.rationale: If user copies while message is streaming, they expect partial output + what's been streamed so far. Copy(finalized only) loses user's streaming context.

gate_b.security_review: PASS (5 findings, 0 blocking after XSS fix with rehype-sanitize)

what_went_well: Pattern reuse from F035 reduced planning time significantly (LOW risk assessed in Phase 1)
Focused scope (7 files, 39 minutes) indicates clear requirements
Security review caught XSS vulnerability before merge — rehype-sanitize is non-negotiable for agent output
Memory leak fix in Phase 4 prevents production issues in long-running UI
what_could_improve: Component duplication (ThinkingBlock) should have been extracted in iteration 2, not iteration 3. Early pattern recognition saves iterations.
Phase 3 iteration 1: Initial implementation didn't anticipate memory leak in clipboard timeout. Consider lint rules to catch missing cleanup functions.
next_time: For streaming UI components, always include pending content in copy/export operations before first submission
Always run rehype-sanitize with react-markdown when rendering untrusted content (agent output, user input, API responses)
In Phase 3 iteration 1, extract any JSX pattern that appears in 2+ components into a shared file immediately

system_confidence.urgency: HIGH (XSS protection is critical for agent output features)
